proposition: Letter 46 to Khwāja Ẓahīr al-Dīn Muḥammad renews an old family friendship and asks after an estranged relative, Khwāja Burhān al-Dīn Yaqīn; MK thinks the addressee may be the copyist of MS Majlis 10196.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Khwāja Ẓahīr al-Dīn Muḥammad
mediation.where: Munshaʾāt-i Turka letter 46; MS Majlis 10196 f. 188b
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
